summary: Task-scoped restatement of DEC-0383 (pr:2427) so the dispatch loop guard accepts it: AISDLC-1196 re-enters once with AI_SDLC_PIPELINE_REF=d63ca322 so the review round runs on the fixed pipeline build and pushes refs/ai-sdlc/verdicts/d63ca322

options.description: Dispatch re-enters AISDLC-1196 once with AI_SDLC_PIPELINE_REF=d63ca322 (same as DEC-0383 pinned-build-reentry)
Leave 1196 held; operator runs the round by hand

body: DEC-0383 was answered pinned-build-reentry by the operator on 2026-11-06, but its scope is pr:2427 and the loop-guard release (`cli-dispatch reenter --decision`) requires a record scoped to the task. This record re-scopes the same ruling to task:AISDLC-1196; it decides nothing new. Dispatch sets AI_SDLC_PIPELINE_REF=d63ca322 in the tmux server environment only around the one executor spawn and unsets it after. 1198 (#2429) and 1189 (#2413) stay held until #2427 merges, then re-enter on main.
